svg.title: Comparison of three PI candidates
svg.desc: In the same setpoint and load trials on the actual heater program, the manual, model-based and relay PI candidates all pass every requirement. The relay gains settle fastest but move the heater command by 135 percentage points, mostly amplified noise; the manual gains move it by only 28 points and settle the load trial at 29.8 seconds, just inside the 30 second limit, so the rule of least heater work picks them.
svg.text: Three PI candidates in the same two trials
Control Studio validation runs on the same heater program and noisy probe · numbers answer the predictions
Load must settle within ±0.1 °C by 30 s
All three pass; the manual gains settle at 29.8 s, 0.2 s inside
Load settling: relay 9.3 s, model-based 26.9 s, manual 29.8 s
Activity: 135, 50 and 28 points; noise alone ≈ 8Kp: 105, 33 and 16
Least heater work: the rule picks the manual gains
